description_en: Queries the progress of an export task
name: DescribeExportInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the export task.
You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ExportRecord](~~ExportRecord~~) operation to initiate an export
parameters.help_zh:
导出任务的ID。
您可以调用[ExportRecord](~~ExportRecord~~)接口发起导出后获取该参数
parameters.name: export_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory.
You can obtain this parameter by invoking the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

CurrentCount.description_en: The number of data entries that have been exported
CurrentCount.description_zh: 当前已导出数据的条数

ExportStatus.description_en:
The status of the export task.

Valid values:

init: export initialization
exporting: export in progress
success: export successful
ExportStatus.description_zh:
导出任务的状态。

取值：

init：导出初始化
exporting：导出进行中
success：导出成功

FileName.description_en: The name of the exported Excel file

Id.description_en: The ID of the export task

Link.description_en: The download URL of the exported Excel file

Message.description_en: The message returned for the export result. Fixed value: success. This value indicates that the export is successful
Message.description_zh: 导出结果提示信息。固定值：success。表示导出成功

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data entries in the exported Excel file
TotalCount.description_zh: 导出的Excel表格中数据的总条数
